description: Register and control CI runners. Actions: create_authentication_token (register a runner, GitLab 16+, returns a one-time token), update (settings), pause/resume (toggle job pickup), delete, reset_authentication_token (rotate the token). Related: browse_runners to discover runners.

access_level.description: Access level: NOT_PROTECTED or REF_PROTECTED (protected refs only) Required for 'create_authentication_token', 'update' action(s).

action.description: Action to perform: create_authentication_token, update, pause, resume, delete, reset_authentication_token

group_id.description: Group full path for a group runner (e.g., 'my-group') Required for 'create_authentication_token' action(s).

locked.description: Lock the runner to its current projects Required for 'create_authentication_token', 'update' action(s).

maintenance_note.description: Free-form maintenance note (Markdown) Required for 'create_authentication_token', 'update' action(s).

maximum_timeout.description: Maximum job timeout in seconds Required for 'create_authentication_token', 'update' action(s).

paused.description: Whether the runner is paused (ignores new jobs) Required for 'create_authentication_token', 'update' action(s).

project_id.description: Project full path for a project runner (e.g., 'my-group/my-project') Required for 'create_authentication_token' action(s).

run_untagged.description: Allow running untagged jobs Required for 'create_authentication_token', 'update' action(s).

runner_id.description: Numeric ID of the runner (from browse_runners); expanded to a global ID internally Required for 'update', 'pause', 'resume', 'delete', 'reset_authentication_token' action(s).

runner_type.description: Runner scope. INSTANCE_TYPE needs admin; GROUP_TYPE/PROJECT_TYPE need the namespace Required for 'create_authentication_token' action(s).

tag_list.description: Tags that determine which jobs run Required for 'create_authentication_token', 'update' action(s).

name: manage_runner
